user.title: Connect to PocketSmith
user.description: Enter your PocketSmith developer key. You can find it under PocketSmith → Settings → API.

data_description.developer_key: Your PocketSmith developer API key. Find it in PocketSmith under Settings → API → Developer Keys.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate PocketSmith
reauth_confirm.description: Your PocketSmith developer key was rejected. Enter a new key to restore the connection.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure PocketSmith
reconfigure.description: Update your PocketSmith developer key. Your existing entity history will be preserved.

data_description.developer_key: Your PocketSmith developer API key. Find it in PocketSmith under Settings → API → Developer Keys.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid developer key. Please check and try again.
error.insufficient_permissions: Your developer key doesn't have the required permissions. In PocketSmith, go to Settings → API and ensure your key has read access.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the PocketSmith API. Check your network connection.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

data_description.update_interval_hours: How often to fetch data from PocketSmith. Lower values use more API quota.
data_description.enable_backfill: Fetch your full transaction history on first setup to populate long-term statistics graphs. Disable if you have a large history and want to avoid the initial API load.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Force an immediate data refresh from PocketSmith.

reset_backfill.name: Reset backfill
reset_backfill.description: Clear historical backfill progress so all accounts are re-swept on the next startup.

get_budget_summary.name: Get budget summary
get_budget_summary.description: Return the current budget summary as structured data for use in automations.

uncategorised_transactions.title: PocketSmith: {count} uncategorised transaction(s)
uncategorised_transactions.description: You have **{count}** uncategorised transaction(s) in PocketSmith. Categorise them to keep your budget data accurate.

over_budget.title: PocketSmith: over budget in {count} categor(y/ies)
over_budget.description: You are over budget this month in **{count}** categor(y/ies): {categories}. Review your spending in PocketSmith.

backfill_failed.title: PocketSmith: historical backfill failed for account '{account}'
backfill_failed.description: The historical data sweep for account **{account}** failed after multiple retries. Statistics for this account may be incomplete. To retry, go to the integration options, disable and re-enable **Enable historical backfill**, then restart Home Assistant.
